summary: The page skeleton: the two-column app shell (sticky left rail plus main column), the navigation with its sliding highlight, the frosted sticky top bar, the content area and page header, the 12-column grid with its `.span-N` helpers, and the first-visit boot screen. Two media queries at the end re-flow the grid on laptops and turn the rail into a bottom tab bar on phones.

notes.text: Section comment, then `.shell`, the app's outer frame: a two-column grid with the rail at `--rail` (236px) and the main column taking the rest. `minmax(0, 1fr)` lets that column shrink below its content's natural width so a wide table can't push the page sideways, and `position: relative; z-index: 1` lifts the whole app above the fixed backdrop.

The left navigation rail. `position: sticky; top: 0` with `height: 100vh` keeps it pinned while the page scrolls; it is a flex column with a hairline right border, and its slightly translucent dark gradient plus `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` gives it a frosted-glass look over the dot-grid backdrop.
`.brand` is the logo link at the top of the rail: a flex row of logo mark and name, with extra bottom padding to separate it from the nav.
The 30px logo SVG; `flex: none` stops it from shrinking when space is tight.
Logo colours: the circuit-like `.trace` strokes are grey (`--t3`) and the `.core` dot is aqua, the brand mark's only spot of colour.
The "IIP" wordmark: semibold 14px with slight letter-spacing and a tight 1.1 line height.
The "integration intelligence" subtitle: `display: block` puts the `small` element on its own line under "IIP", in small `--t3` Geist Mono.

The nav container: a flex column of links with 1px gaps that scrolls vertically if the rail is too short. `position: relative` makes it the positioning context for the absolutely positioned `.nav-indicator`.
Padding for the group headings ("Monitor", "Engine", "Platform"), which also carry the `.eyebrow` class for their typography.

Each nav link: a 34px-tall flex row (icon, label, shortcut hint) with small rounded corners and secondary text colour, easing its colour and background over `--fast`. `position: relative; z-index: 1` keeps the links above the sliding indicator behind them.
Nav icons are drawn with `stroke="currentColor"`, so setting `color` here makes them a dimmer grey than the label, with a matching colour transition.
Hover state: brighter text and a barely visible 3% white background.
The current page's link, marked with the `active` class by the router in main.js: white text, and its icon turns aqua.

The keyboard shortcut hint (for example "G O") is pushed to the right with `margin-left: auto` and hidden with `opacity: 0`; hovering the link fades it in, so the rail stays calm until you need the hint.

The sliding highlight behind the active link, one shared element: absolutely positioned across the nav's full width, 34px tall to match a link, with an `--s3` fill and a 1px inset `box-shadow` that acts as a border without affecting layout. `moveIndicator()` in main.js springs its vertical position to the active link's `offsetTop`, and `pointer-events: none` lets clicks pass through to the links.

A 2px glowing aqua bar on the indicator's left side. `left: -12px` pushes it into the rail's 12px padding so it sits on the rail's outer edge, the `top`/`bottom` insets make it shorter than the link, and because it belongs to the indicator it slides along with it.

The red badge next to "Incidents" with the open-incident count (main.js fills it in and toggles its `hidden` attribute). It is pushed right, set in small mono type with an 18px line height, and uses the critical colour on its soft tint because it counts unresolved risk.
The rail footer: `margin-top: auto` pushes it to the bottom of the flex column, and it stacks its cards in a grid below a hairline divider.
The small bordered cards in the footer that hold the live-connection status and the live-traffic switch.
A row inside a rail card: label on the left, control on the right (`justify-content: space-between`).
Section comment, then `.main`, the right-hand column: a flex column whose `min-width: 0` lets it shrink inside the grid instead of growing to fit wide content.

The top bar: `position: sticky; top: 0` keeps it visible while scrolling and `z-index: 20` keeps it above page content. Its 78%-opaque background with `backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%)` lets content scrolling underneath show through as a soft, slightly more saturated blur, separated by a hairline bottom border.
The breadcrumb ("NovaBank / Overview"): a small flex row in dim `--t3` text.
The current page name in the breadcrumb (`#crumb`, updated by the router), highlighted in white at medium weight.
An empty spacer with `flex: 1` that absorbs the free space, pushing the search button and clock to the right.

The search button that opens the command palette: a 34px field-like flex row whose width is `min(340px, 34vw)` so it shrinks on narrower windows, with a hairline border, `--s1` fill, dim text and transitions for its hover change.
On hover the search button's border switches to the stronger control colour `--line-ctl`, and its background and text brighten slightly.
Pushes the "Ctrl K" key hint to the right end of the search button (main.js swaps the text to "⌘ K" on Apple devices).
The UTC clock in the top bar, rewritten every second by `startClock()` in main.js: medium 12px mono in `--t2`.
The "UTC" suffix inside the clock, dimmed to `--t4` so the time itself stands out.
Section comment, then `.view`, the `main` element every page renders into: generous padding (extra at the bottom), a 1560px maximum width and auto side margins that centre it on very wide screens.
The page header: a flex row with the title block on the left and actions on the right, aligned along their bottom edges and wrapping onto two lines when space runs out.
Page titles use Instrument Serif at 40px with a tight 1.05 line height and slight negative letter-spacing; the serif headline is the main typographic contrast in an otherwise sans and mono interface.
The italic second word of each title (such as "center" in "Command center") is set in `--t2`, an accent made with typography instead of colour.
The intro paragraph under the title, in secondary grey and capped at 640px so lines stay comfortable to read.
The container for header buttons and tags: a wrapping flex row with 8px gaps.

The layout grid: 12 equal columns with 14px gaps. `minmax(0, 1fr)` instead of plain `1fr` lets columns shrink below their content's minimum width, so a long table or label can't stretch one column wider than the others.
The adjacent-sibling selector `+` adds 14px between two consecutive grids, matching the gap inside a grid so rows of panels are evenly spaced.

Column-span helpers: `.span-N` makes an element cover N of the 12 columns (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 12 are defined). For example, four `.span-3` KPI cards fill a row, and the `.span-8` map sits beside the `.span-4` live feed.

Section comment, then `.boot`, the full-screen first-visit intro: fixed over the whole viewport at `z-index: 100` (above everything else) on the solid page background, with its content centred by `display: grid; place-items: center`.
The boot content column: at most 420px wide (or 86% of the viewport on phones), a grid with 22px gaps and items aligned to the left.
The logo row is a flex row of mark and title, and the logo SVG inside it is 44px square.
Boot logo colours: the traces use a brighter `--t2` than in the rail and the core dot is aqua. boot.js draws the traces in stroke by stroke and pops the core in with a scale animation.
The "Integration Intelligence" title in 30px Instrument Serif.

The status lines container: a grid of small mono lines in `--t3`. `min-height: 92px` reserves room for all four lines up front, so the progress bar below doesn't shift down as boot.js appends each line.
Each status line is a flex row with a 10px gap between the check mark and the text.
The check marks in front of each line are aqua.
The progress track: a full-width 2px `--s3` line with rounded ends; `overflow: hidden` clips the fill inside it.

The progress fill: a full-width aqua bar with a glow, collapsed with `transform: scaleX(0)` from a left `transform-origin`. boot.js animates `scaleX` up step by step, and scaling (rather than changing `width`) is cheap for the browser because it doesn't trigger layout.
The "press any key to skip" hint in small, faint mono type.
Section comment, then a media query for windows 1180px wide or narrower (small laptops and tablets), where the column spans are re-flowed.
`.span-2` cards widen to a third of the row (span 4), `.span-3` to half (span 6), and `.span-4`/`.span-5` also become half width, so KPI cards sit two per row.
Wide panels (`.span-7`, `.span-8`) go full width (span 12), and the closing brace ends the query; `.span-6` and `.span-12` are unchanged at this size.
A media query for phones and narrow tablets (860px and below), where the rail turns into a bottom tab bar and the content stacks.
The shell drops to a single column, since the rail no longer sits beside the content.

The rail becomes a bar fixed to the bottom of the screen: full width, automatic height, a horizontal flex row with small padding, and a top hairline instead of the right one. `z-index: 30` keeps it above the content and the top bar.
Hides what doesn't fit in a tab bar: the brand, the rail footer cards, the group headings, the shortcut hints and the incident count badge.
The nav becomes a horizontal row that scrolls sideways if the icons don't fit.
Links keep their natural width (`flex: none`) with a little side padding, and every `span` inside them, including the text label, is hidden, leaving an icon-only tab bar.
Hides the indicator's vertical aqua bar, which only makes sense along the left edge of a vertical rail.

Top bar adjustments: `.topbar` gets 16px side padding, `.search-trigger` shrinks to fit its contents, and the search button's text label and the `.clock` are hidden, leaving just the search icon and key hint.
The content area gets 16px gutters and 96px of bottom padding, so the last panel isn't hidden behind the fixed bottom tab bar.
Page titles shrink from 40px to 32px.

`.span-2` metric cards go two per row (span 6) and `.span-3` to `.span-6` all go full width; `.span-7`/`.span-8` are already full width because the 1180px query still applies at this size. The closing brace ends the query.
